# Delivery: CI/CD and environments · project standards (detail)

<!-- docs/standards/delivery.md · Generated by project-init v0.4.1 on 2026-11-17.
On-demand reference: not loaded automatically. The short rules Claude follows are in .claude/rules/delivery.md. -->

## CI on every change
- **Rule:** Every push and pull request runs ruff (lint and format check), mypy, import-linter, pytest, the `requirements.txt` check and gitleaks.
- **Why:** Problems show up minutes after they are introduced.
- **Status:** Enforced (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`).

## Environment parity
- **Rule:** Local runs and the deployed app use the same pinned dependencies and Python version.
- **Why:** Differences between environments cause "it worked locally".
- **Status:** Enforced: CI checks that `requirements.txt` matches `uv.lock`, and `.python-version` pins Python. The Python version on Streamlit Community Cloud is set by hand in the deploy settings.

## Build once, promote
- **Rule:** Not applied. Streamlit Community Cloud builds the app from the repository itself.
- **Decision:** Kept the current hosting (SPEC section 6).
- **Status:** Kept current (doesn't fit the platform).

## Infrastructure as code
- **Rule:** Not applied. Streamlit Community Cloud has no infrastructure-as-code interface. The few deploy settings are described in the README.
- **Decision:** Kept the current hosting (SPEC section 6).
- **Status:** Kept current (doesn't fit the platform).

## Pipelines as code, fast feedback
- **Rule:** The pipeline lives in the repo. Every job has a timeout, and superseded runs on the same branch are cancelled.
- **Why:** Slow or stuck pipelines get bypassed.
- **Status:** Pipelines-as-code is Enforced. Job timeouts are Adopting. Cancelling superseded runs is planned for M2.

## Pipeline security
- **Rule:** The workflow token is read-only by default. Third-party actions are pinned to a full commit SHA with a version comment, and Dependabot updates the pins. `pull_request_target` is never combined with a checkout of the pull request's code.
- **Why:** A moved action tag can run someone else's code in your pipeline.
- **Status:** The read-only token is Enforced. SHA pinning is Adopting for new actions; pinning the existing actions is planned for M2.

## Automated pipeline checks
- **Rule:** Lint the workflows (actionlint), scan them for security issues (zizmor), and run the OpenSSF Scorecard on a schedule.
- **Why:** Pipeline misconfigurations are invisible in normal reviews.
- **Status:** Planned for M2.

## Flaky tests are quarantined
- **Rule:** An intermittently failing test gets an issue and is fixed or deleted. It is never re-run until green as a habit.
- **Why:** Flaky tests teach people to ignore red builds.
- **Status:** Adopting.
